description: An oscillator whose wave is pushed through three frequency-modulation stages in series and then a smoother, with every stage brought out on its own jack

params.text: Shifts the pitch by up to five octaves either way; with a cable in the 1V/OCT jack it moves in whole octaves only
Trims the pitch by up to a tenth of an octave either way
Scales the COARSE control input before it is added to the COARSE knob, an octave per volt at full amount
Scales the FINE control input before it is added to the FINE knob; its tooltip reads Coarse CV Amount, which is the maker's mistake
Scales the waveform control input before it is added to the waveform knob
Sweeps the wave from sine through triangle and saw to square; the last quarter of its travel gives the same square as the three-quarter point, because the pulse width it computes is discarded
Scales the FM 1 control input before it is added to the FM 1 amount, a tenth per volt at full amount
Sets how far the first stage modulates the oscillator; with nothing in its modulator jack the stage modulates itself
Scales the FM 2 control input before it is added to the FM 2 amount, a tenth per volt at full amount
Sets how far the second stage modulates the first stage's output; with nothing in its modulator jack the stage modulates itself
Scales the FM 3 control input before it is added to the FM 3 amount, a tenth per volt at full amount
Sets how far the third stage modulates the second stage's output; with nothing in its modulator jack the stage modulates itself
Scales the SMOOTH control input before it is added to the SMOOTH knob, a tenth per volt at full amount
Slews the third stage's output, taking the high frequencies off it in a way close to a lowpass filter

inputs.text: Added to the COARSE knob through its CV knob, an octave per volt at full amount
Added to the FINE knob through its CV knob, a fiftieth of an octave per volt at full amount
Added to the waveform knob through its CV knob, half a step along the wave sweep per volt at full amount
Added to the FM 1 amount through its CV knob, a tenth per volt at full amount
The signal that modulates the first stage; with nothing patched here the stage modulates itself with its own carrier
Added to the FM 2 amount through its CV knob, a tenth per volt at full amount
The signal that modulates the second stage; with nothing patched here the stage modulates itself with its own carrier
Added to the FM 3 amount through its CV knob, a tenth per volt at full amount
The signal that modulates the third stage; with nothing patched here the stage modulates itself with its own carrier
Added to the SMOOTH knob through its CV knob, a tenth per volt at full amount
Sets the pitch, a volt an octave with 0V giving C4 at 261.63Hz; the channel count on this cable is what sets the module's polyphony

outputs.text: The bare wave from the oscillator, before any of the modulation stages
The wave after the first modulation stage
The wave after the second modulation stage
The wave after the third modulation stage
The third stage's output after the smoother

notes: the 1V/OCT jack alone sets how many channels the module runs; with nothing patched there it is monophonic and the pitch comes from the COARSE and FINE knobs
a stage with an empty modulator jack takes its modulator from its own carrier, which is what makes this a self-modulating oscillator rather than a pair of them
pushing the waveform past its top with CV leaves the oscillator holding its last value instead of a wave, because no shape is defined past that point
